guide.label: Sample project guide
guide.ending: That is the whole loop. Now point it at your own code.

spec.title: The spec
spec.body: These three specs are written for you. Each says what to build and how to know it is done.

rail.title: The rail
rail.body: A rail takes one spec through to a finished change: it writes it, tests it, then stops for you. Start the first one.

review.title: The review
review.body: Nothing is merged on its own. When the run ends, a Review packet shows what changed and lets you accept or discard it.

run.noProvider: No AI provider is ready on this machine, so a real run isn't possible yet. A recorded run shows the same path.

run.recordingNote: It is a recording: nothing runs and nothing is charged.
run.started: Started. It takes about {{low}}–{{high}} min; follow it in the rail.
run.preparing: Preparing the project's workspace. This only takes a moment.
run.workspaceFailed: The workspace could not be prepared.
run.overBudget: Today's budget is already reached. Raise it in Analytics ▸ Budget, then try again.
run.failed: Couldn't start the run. Try again.
